findings.defect: The draft supplies the threat before Taekyung gets to finish it for him.
findings.rationale: The Demon Lord stops after naming Taekyung’s mouth; the verb comes from Taekyung in the next line.

findings.defect: Taekyung’s completion of the threat loses the explicit act of tearing.
findings.rationale: 찢어 주마 means he will tear it; it completes the Demon Lord’s unfinished line.

findings.current: The guys who said that to me are lined up in two rows, counting off, and running laps around the Murim Alliance training ground.
findings.defect: The men Taekyung killed become living runners, and a column becomes two rows.
findings.rationale: 죽은 애들이 identifies the dead; 두 바퀴 measures how far their formation would extend, not laps they run.
findings.replacement: The guys who said that to me and died could line up in a column, count off, and stretch twice around the Murim Alliance training ground.
findings.source: 나한테 그 말 했다가 죽은 애들이 사열 종대 앉아 번호로 무림맹 연무장 두 바퀴야.

findings.current: “For the record, this old man has run more than ten laps.”
findings.defect: Jeok says his own tally exceeds ten circuits, not that he ran them.
findings.rationale: His line extends Taekyung’s joke about lining up the people who died after saying it.
findings.replacement: “For the record, mine would stretch more than ten times around.”

findings.current: “So don’t do anything stupid like fighting as if your life depends on it.
findings.defect: The idiom makes the fight sound necessary for survival rather than warning Taekyung not to stake his life on it.
findings.rationale: 목숨 걸고 싸우는 refers to fighting at the risk of one’s life, the behavior Jeok wants him to avoid.
findings.replacement: “So don’t do anything stupid like risking your life in a fight.
findings.source: “그러니 목숨 걸고 싸우는 멍청한 짓거리 따위는 하지 마라.

findings.current: “If you keep that promise, what will you give me?”
findings.defect: The draft reverses who must keep the promise.
findings.rationale: Taekyung is asking what Jeok will give him if he follows Jeok’s request to stay alive.
findings.replacement: “If I keep that promise, what will you give me?”

findings.current: “Do you remember the promise you made me long ago?”
findings.defect: A promise made with the speaker becomes a promise made to him, weakening the deliberate echo between the two conversations.
findings.rationale: 나와 했던 describes a promise made with the speaker. The wording recurs when Jeok addresses Taekyung.
findings.replacement: “Do you remember the promise we made long ago?”

findings.current: “Do you remember the promise you made me long ago?”
findings.defect: Jeok’s echo of the Demon Lord’s question likewise changes a shared promise into one made to him.
findings.rationale: 노부와 했던 means made with this old man; retaining the parallel preserves the setup for Taekyung’s refusal to play along.
findings.replacement: “Do you remember the promise we made long ago?”

summary: Several action and relationship details are altered, particularly the opening exchange, the training-ground joke, and the promise between Taekyung and Jeok Cheongang.
